text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the start of the new year, the URA holds
an award ceremony for the Umamusume
who excelled in the previous year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "From the representatives of each generation and route, an Umamusume worthy of being last year's face will be chosen. In that case, naturally—"

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
And now, for the grand finale!
The Best Classic-tier Queen Umamusume and—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
The double recipient of the Umamusume of the Year award,
Gentildonna-san!
Please come up to the stage!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
In addition to her great success on the Tiara route last year,
she even overcame Orfevre-san
to seize victory in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time in history a Tiara Umamusume has conquered the Japan Cup in her Classic year!
She has shown strength that transcends generations.

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
For those achievements, the Best Classic-Grade Queen Umamusume
is selected by unanimous vote!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand Gentildonna's thoughts.
She wasn't chosen unanimously for Horse of the Year—
and that must be what leaves her dissatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"I am deeply honored and delighted
to receive such a prestigious award."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I shall strive even harder this year, so that
I may present results clear for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
It appears Gentile has obtained
one massive source of power.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Younger Brother
text_block_list.text:
"...My racing achievements seem to carry influence.
Yet, I still cannot be called the strongest.
Isn't that right, Father?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna's Father
text_block_list.text:
…………
However, if it's that girl—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
With that,
this concludes the awards ceremony—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
NGWAAAH! Parade Nu!!
Where's my tunaaaa?!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: Huh!? Gold Ship-san!? Huh? Just a second ago... Huh!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Gold Ship was also honored today as the Best Classic Umamusume. She was supposed to attend normally in her school uniform, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Gentil,
it's you, huh..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You ruined my!!
Blackthroat seaperch feast...!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Is something wrong with that?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Fine, I get it.
I get it, I'll let ya win this one.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I hooked a tuna.
No doubt about it. It was heavy, alright.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Still, your haul was bigger...
You even grabbed that marlin by the snout, dammit.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We've got sashimi, we've got platters!
—Then next up is the giant octopus, let's gooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
ALLLRIIIGHT!!
The Bermuda is calling my name!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship sprinted away like a gale-force wind.
I thought even the unflappable Gentildonna
might be taken aback, but...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho...
Now I have even more to look forward to.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After the awards ceremony, during an interview discussing future prospects for the Senior year...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
A question for you, Trainer!
Winning the Japan Cup was a key factor in receiving Umamusume of the Year, but—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
How do you analyze your victory?
Were there any conditions that worked in your favor?
choice_data_list: (So they don't think it was a complete victory, huh)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The first Classic-year Tiara Umamusume to do so, and to take victory over that absolute strongest Umamusume, Orfevre. Some might see it that way. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Putting it into words solidified the goal once more.
This year, it had to be proven without fail.
Regardless of the conditions, regardless of the opponent—"
choice_data_list: She'll win simply because she is stronger than anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, Gentildonna will be unanimously elected
Umamusume of the Year,
leaving behind the greatest track record in history"—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Quite high-spirited,
aren't we?
choice_data_list: Once you say it out loud, it becomes real.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. Words hold power too... When combined with pride, they bring you closer to reality.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Looks like you've learned a bit of the way of the strong too."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just then—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ms. Gentile~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hello~♪
Congratulations on winning Umamusume of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Curren Chan.
Currently active in sprints, she's a powerhouse who was just awarded Best Senior Queen Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Congratulations to you as well.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren was aiming for that too, though~
Umamusume of the Year! It's proof that you truly went viral, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren is on Umastagram!
Could you take out your phone?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's the account!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Curren Chan's social media account, I was amazed.
She had a massive following,
a clear testament to her immense influence.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Please be sure to follow along just like that♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's right!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Do you have some free time after this?
Curren wants to hang out with you, Gentildonna-san♪"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... You want to play with me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Without opportunities like this, we barely get to hang out at all!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I turn my gaze toward Gentildonna.
How will she decide...?
I half-expected her to refuse, but—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I do not mind.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh?
Are you sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, was that polite lip service
under the assumption you'd be turned down?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No?
It's just...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Even if you said no, I was totally gonna convince you anyway!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Curren's just bummed that she couldn't show off her true "power"♪

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Hohohoho.
Coming from you, I suppose that makes sense.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So? How do you intend to use your power
to entertain me?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
About that!
I saw this area on Umastagram
and I'm really curious about it!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Why don't we try
one of them together?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan showed me three options.
Among them, the one that caught my attention the most was—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
It's stiff, isn't it...
For now, let's take a look.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: So, this is the one everyone's talking about?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It's frozen solid with some mysterious tech,
and apparently it won't melt unless you use a special heat-conducting spoon!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's trending on UmaTok to post how
many seconds it takes to eat the first bite—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Um, Gentile-san?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Heat is something born from muscle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: In other words, if you learn how to use your muscles and delicately focus your power—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Naive.
...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Whoa.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I forgot to weigh mine!
Gentildonna-san, one more time for Curren, please~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the exquisite ice cream
helped Gentildonna relax.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
You've got great taste♪"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "That shrine is located deep within a rugged mountain, and apparently, it's super tough to get there!"
choice_data_list: Maybe that means the blessings are just as great.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, shall we go ask?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we headed deep into the mountains for our
New Year's shrine visit—
but the path proved to be extraordinarily treacherous.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, next we're crossing the stepping stones, right?
Let's get through it quick and easy!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOOOOM...)
choice_data_list: (S-She built a bridge out of giant boulders...!)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Jumping around is quite unrefined.
Please cross over using that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, as expectedâª
Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I desperately scrambled to keep up
with the two Umamusume as they effortlessly forged
their own path through the wilderness—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, so this is the place...!
It's got such a nice atmosphere. It feels like it'll bring good fortune♪

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Well then, we'll be on our way.
choice_data_list: Eeeh, what about making a shrine visit...?!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It's useless. Because—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Any divine blessing earned from such an easy path would surely be worthless."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Insta-worthy...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Then by all means, go ahead and try.
Be my guest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... with Gentildonna watching over us,
for some reason I ended up doing an Insta-worthy
photo challenge with Curren Chan.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Since it's New Year's,
let's make a kagami mochi together!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
—That's it!
Make a big circle with your cheeks~

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Giggle.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, do pardon me.
Please, do go on.
choice_data_list: …Why don’t you give it a try too?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
It'd definitely be super cute!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, even if it isn't mochi...
Just like this♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey, cute, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes, they are exceptionally cute.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "Now, take a... very close look at me."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—Even without doing a thing,
isn't it charming enough?
